questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Milan is quite similar to Copenhagen in comparison to other Italian larger cities. Therefore it was easy, even though the culture is more as can be expected in south of Europe.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Use WhatsApp

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The perception of time

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The Milanese people are very welcoming and dear.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Everything will work out, relax and enjoy

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: You might have to follow classes in different buildings and not only the main building at the University. Ask for information at the information points.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Believe in patience

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Some professors are not very informative on which outcome they expect in relation to the exam. You cannot be certain to e.g. see an exam from a previous year and therefore you cannot really know how to prepare exactly.
